clouds.limits: Rendered cloud context. Product timestamps, not per-pixel acquisition times. Day/night composite treatments differ. No cloud-motion vector or rainfall inferred.

radar.origin: Keskkonnaagentuur / Harku and Sürgavere weather radars
radar.limits: Radar-derived rain-rate estimates, not rain-gauge accumulations. Two contributing radars, one derived composite. Corner-anchored Mercator registration, footprint checked but not surveyed or provider-confirmed. Source scales and LR latitude still conflict. Approximate map-cell coordinates only. ODIM product-interval labels retained; underlying sweep and pixel acquisition unknown. No-data and below-detection remain distinct.

buoys.limits: Hourly requested samples, not a continuous wave record. Nulls stay missing. Direction means from. Directional spread is not a confidence interval. First publication and station receipt times unknown.
